items.stem: Which protocol resolves a known IPv4 address to the MAC address needed to deliver a frame on the local network?

options.rationale: Correct: ARP maps an IP address to a MAC address on the local link.
DNS resolves names to IP addresses, not IP to MAC.
DHCP assigns IP configuration; it does not resolve IP to MAC.
HTTP is an application protocol, unrelated to IP-to-MAC resolution.

items.explanation: Correct: ARP maps an IP address to a MAC address on the local link.

items.stem: Which two statements about TCP and UDP are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: TCP establishes a connection with a three-way handshake before data transfer
options.rationale: Correct: TCP uses SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK to set up a connection.

options.text: UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery or ordering
options.rationale: Correct: UDP sends datagrams without connection setup or delivery guarantees.

options.text: UDP guarantees in-order, reliable delivery like TCP
options.rationale: UDP provides no delivery or ordering guarantees.

options.text: TCP sends data without any acknowledgements
options.rationale: TCP uses acknowledgements to provide reliability.

items.explanation: Correct: TCP uses SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK to set up a connection.; Correct: UDP sends datagrams without connection setup or delivery guarantees.

items.stem: Using a layered troubleshooting method, what should you generally verify before blaming the web application?

options.text: Lower-layer connectivity such as link, IP addressing, routing and DNS resolution
options.rationale: Correct: confirming the lower layers first isolates the fault efficiently.

options.text: The colour scheme of the website
options.rationale: Presentation styling is unrelated to connectivity faults.

options.text: The number of images on the page
options.rationale: Image count does not explain a failure to connect.

options.text: The user's choice of browser theme
options.rationale: Browser theme has no bearing on network connectivity.

items.explanation: Correct: confirming the lower layers first isolates the fault efficiently.
